battle.name: 里姆辛一世的行動
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞南部拉爾薩平原
battle.brief: 前1822年里姆辛一世即位拉爾薩，率阿摩利特聯軍在幼發拉底下游與巴比倫、埃什努納角力六十年，並借埃蘭援軍掌控烏爾與烏魯克；前1763年漢摩拉比圍困拉爾薩城達三月，城破後里姆辛王朝覆亡。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，形制與本役步兵的銅矛頭木杆長矛同源，是近身搏鬥的骨幹兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場衝突自前1822年里姆辛一世登上拉爾薩王位起，延續到前1763年拉爾薩城被攻破為止，交手者是幼發拉底河中下游的幾個城邦王國，而不是有條約約束的現代國際。拉爾薩一方是阿摩利特人第一王朝的拉爾薩王國，王庭設在沙塔-恩-納希爾運河兩岸的都城拉爾薩；里姆辛一世是首位留下完整年名的拉爾薩君主，他把王權與軍權合於一身，烏爾、烏魯克、尼普爾、基什、埃里都等城邦名義上臣服，實則各城仍自有民兵與城防指揮，拉爾薩王主要靠派駐軍隊與年名制度的宣示維繫秩序。巴比倫一方同出阿摩利特人，王位在蘇姆-伊盧姆之後傳到辛-穆巴利特，這一時期真正掌兵的是王族成員漢摩拉比，他以王之將軍的身分調度城邦徵召的步兵與車兵，後來正式即位。埃什努納是迪亞拉河谷的獨立王國，先與拉爾薩並肩對抗巴比倫，後來轉而倒向漢摩拉比，成為拉爾薩側翼最致命的威脅。埃蘭以蘇斯為王庭，是拉爾薩最可靠的外援，屢次以車兵與步兵渡過幼發拉底下游投入戰役。馬里控制中游商路，國王齊姆里利姆在拉爾薩與埃蘭的壓力下退守埃什努納並被殺，馬里本身最終也為漢摩拉比所滅。亞述與蘇美爾各城多在兩強之間觀望，時而倒向得勢的一方。
countriesEn: This conflict began when Rim-Sin I took the throne of Larsa in 1822 BC and ran until the fall of the city of Larsa in 1763 BC; the belligerents were the city-state kingdoms of the middle and lower Euphrates rather than a modern international order held together by treaties. On the Larsa side stood the Kingdom of Larsa of the first Amorite dynasty, with its royal court in the capital Larsa on both banks of the Shatt-en-Nahil canal. Rim-Sin I was the first Larsa ruler to leave a complete set of year names behind, and he fused royal and military authority in his own person. Ur, Uruk, Nippur, Kish and Eridu were nominally subject to him, yet each city kept its own militia and its own command over the defences, and the king of Larsa held his position mainly by garrisoning troops in the cities and by the public display of his year-name system. The Babylonian side came from the same Amorite people; the throne passed from Sumu-ilum to Sin-Muballit, and the man who really held the army in this period was a member of the royal family, Hammurabi, who directed the infantry and chariotry levied from the cities in the capacity of the king's general before he formally took the throne himself. Eshnunna, an independent kingdom in the Diyala valley, first stood shoulder to shoulder with Larsa against Babylon and then turned to Hammurabi's side, becoming the gravest danger to Larsa's flank. Elam, whose royal court sat at Susa, was Larsa's most dependable ally and repeatedly threw chariots and infantry across the lower Euphrates into the fighting. Mari controlled the trade routes of the middle river; its king Zimri-Lim, squeezed by Larsa and Elam, fell back to Eshnunna and was killed there, and Mari itself was eventually destroyed by Hammurabi. Assyria and the Sumerian cities mostly watched from the sidelines, joining whichever side was ascendant.
people: 核心人物是拉爾薩王里姆辛一世，他的名號寫作里姆辛，本義為月神的野牛，在位上以一紙長達數十年的年名記錄每一次軍事行動，是兩河流域早期年表最完整的一批資料。他出自拉爾薩王朝，其父恩南納圖姆一世曾趁第三王朝衰落時在南部與烏爾一帶爭雄，祖父那皮爾-阿蘇則是拉爾薩王朝的開創者。里姆辛的弟弟瓦拉德-辛在他身後繼位不久便兵敗，僅憑一封致埃什努納王的書信留下記錄；里姆辛之子恩南納圖姆二世是他們的末代君主，也是前1763年拉爾薩城被攻破時的守軍首腦，隨後下落不明。對面的巴比倫方面，蘇姆-伊盧姆在位時巴比倫受埃蘭壓迫，辛-穆巴利特承接王位後節節退讓，直到王族成員漢摩拉比出面主持軍務。漢摩拉比是這場戰爭的另一個樞紐：他把援軍調度與攻城工程一手抓在手上，圍困拉爾薩的壕溝、封鎖水路的部署與最後的總攻都出自其指揮，戰後他順勢登基並統合兩河。馬里王齊姆里利姆在拉爾薩與埃蘭的進逼下兩度遷都，最後在埃什努納遇害。埃什努納與埃蘭各有自己的君主與將領，名字在殘存文獻中多已失傳，而年名記錄官、書記官、銅器匠與車匠則構成了這些行動背後的技術班底。
peopleEn: The central figure is the king of Larsa, Rim-Sin I, whose name, written with the sign for the wild bull of the moon, stands at the head of a sequence of year names that record his military undertakings year by year and form one of the fullest early chronologies of the two rivers. He came out of the Larsa dynasty: his father Enannatum I had already fought for dominance in the south around Ur as the third dynasty of Ur collapsed, and his grandfather Napir-Asu had founded the Larsa dynasty itself. Rim-Sin's brother Warad-Sin succeeded him briefly and was defeated; only a single letter addressed to the king of Eshnunna preserves his trace. Rim-Sin's son Enannatum II was the last ruler of the house and the commander of the garrison when Larsa fell in 1763 BC; what became of him afterwards is unknown. On the Babylonian side, Sumu-ilum had seen Babylon pressed by Elam during his reign, and Sin-Muballit inherited a throne that was giving ground step by step until a member of the royal family, Hammurabi, took charge of the war. Hammurabi is the other pivot of the whole affair: he kept the movement of the relief armies and the engineering of the siege in his own hands, and the circumvallation, the blocking of the waterways and the final assault against Larsa were all his work; after the victory he took the throne and united the two rivers. Zimri-Lim of Mari moved his court twice under the pressure of Larsa and Elam and was finally killed at Eshnunna. Eshnunna and Elam each had their own kings and commanders, most of whose names have not survived, while the year-name scribes, the record keepers, the bronze workers and the wheelwrights formed the skilled body behind all of these undertakings.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期的工藝：銅或青銅矛頭，中空套合或以纏繩綁紮於木杆，握持段留出手可抓握的纏紮處。本役的拉爾薩與巴比倫步兵在形制上屬同一技術家族，考古所得的蘇美爾與阿摩利特墓葬中常見葉形銅矛頭，裝在兩公尺上下甚至更長的木杆上，與埃及的樣式只在細節工藝上不同，因此這張卡指的正是那一代士兵手上的骨幹兵器。除長矛外，本役裝備的核心還有幾類：車兵使用的四輪戰車，實心車軸、輻條車輪、車身以木構蒙皮，四匹馬挽曳，編制為一名御者加一名攜矛或持斧的戰士；步兵除長矛外備柳條與皮革複合的盾，內襯毛氈，用以護住肩背；弓兵使用木與角製的複合弓，箭鏃有石、骨、銅三種；近身搏鬥另有雙面銅斧與短匕首。攻城方面，漢摩拉比的隊伍使用環城的壕溝、壘土牆與木製撞槌，蘇美爾文獻提到的攻城車也屬同類器材。運輸與補給靠沙塔-恩-納希爾運河與陸上行軍，軍隊攜帶的物資以穀物、羊毛、鹽、油為主，並靠驢騾馱運行李。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the craft of the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head, socketed onto or lashed to a wooden shaft, with a binding at the grip so that the hand has something to hold. The infantry of Larsa and Babylon in this war belong to the same technological family. Excavated Sumerian and Amorite burials regularly yield leaf-shaped copper spearheads mounted on shafts around two metres or even longer, differing from the Egyptian example only in detail workmanship, so the card stands for the principal weapon in the hands of the soldiers of that generation. Beyond the spear, the equipment of this campaign includes several other categories. The chariot troops used four-wheeled war chariots with a solid axle, spoked wheels and a wooden body covered with hide, drawn by four animals and organised as one driver plus one warrior carrying a spear or an axe. Infantry apart from their spears carried composite shields of wicker and leather lined with felt to protect the shoulder and back. Archers used composite bows of wood and horn, with arrowheads of stone, bone and copper. Close combat was also carried on with double-edged bronze axes and short daggers. On the siege side, Hammurabi's men worked a circumvallation ditch, earth walls and wooden battering rams, and the siege engines named in Sumerian literature belong to the same family of devices. Transport and supply ran on the Shatt-en-Nahil canal and on marches overland; the goods the armies carried were chiefly grain, wool, salt and oil, with donkeys and mules carrying the baggage.
tactics: 拉爾薩的野戰以車兵為骨幹：四匹馬的車列在開闊的南部平原上展開，車前步兵以長矛結成的密集隊形接敵，車隊的衝鋒用來撕開陣線，步兵隨即填入缺口；由埃蘭運來的車兵與拉爾薩的步兵聯合進攻，兩個方向同時壓向幼發拉底東岸，而巴比倫方向則以烏爾、烏魯克一線作為側翼屏障。里姆辛一世的作戰高度依賴河運：拉爾薩的糧秣、兵源與援軍都沿沙塔-恩-納希爾運河與幼發拉底主航道輸送，運河既作補給線也作側翼防線，一旦被切斷，拉爾薩在戰略上便失去縱深。攻城戰的部署更見講究：漢摩拉比先以步兵封鎖城的陸路出口，同時築壕溝環城，並在運河與護城水系上架設堤壩攔截城內的船隻與援兵；待援軍被逐漸消耗，才把撞槌推向城牆，步兵則在攻城車與土壘掩護下貼近牆根，長矛自盾後伸出亂刺，壓制城頭的守軍。拉爾薩守軍依托城牆、塔樓與城內水道反擊，火箭與投石壓制接近的車隊，並在缺口被突破後退入內城，最後由城防指揮官率殘部與王族一同被俘。整場戰役最關鍵的轉折並非城牆本身，而是埃什努納的倒戈：它從拉爾薩的側翼抽走一支原可依賴的援軍，使拉爾薩被迫兩面作戰，而里姆辛聯軍內部部族與聯盟之間的裂痕，也在長期消耗中逐步擴大。
tacticsEn: Larsa's field warfare was built on the chariot: teams of four animals deployed across the open southern plain, the infantry closing in phalanx-like masses of spears, the chariots used to open the enemy line and the foot soldiers then filling the gaps. Chariots brought down from Elam fought in combination with Larsa's infantry, pressing on two axes towards the eastern bank of the Euphrates, while the line of Ur and Uruk served as a protective flank against Babylon. Rim-Sin I's warfare leaned heavily on river transport: grain, recruits and reinforcements all moved along the Shatt-en-Nahil canal and the main Euphrates channel, and the canal served both as a supply line and as a defensive flank, so that once it was cut Larsa lost its strategic depth. The siege was the more carefully staged operation. Hammurabi first sealed the land approaches with infantry, then dug a ditch around the city and raised dams on the canal and the water defences to intercept the boats and reinforcements inside; only after the relieving armies had been whittled away did he push the battering rams against the walls, while his infantry closed to the base of the ramparts under the cover of the siege engines and earthworks, thrusting spears out from behind shields and pinning the defenders on the wall. The garrison of Larsa replied from the walls, the towers and the internal waterways, using fire arrows and stones to keep the attacking teams at a distance, and after the breach was made they withdrew into the inner city, where the last troops and the royal family were taken. The decisive turn of the whole campaign was not the wall itself but the defection of Eshnunna: it removed from Larsa's flank an ally that could otherwise have been relied upon, forced the city to fight on two fronts, and the fissures between the clans and the allies of Rim-Sin's coalition widened steadily as the campaign dragged on.
data: 可用的數字大致如下：里姆辛一世在位約六十年，維基百科條目瑞姆辛一世以約前1822年至約前1763年為其統治期，逐年名目現存於 CDLI 所藏的 Rim-Sin I Year Names；同一條目另記聯軍占領拉爾薩約在前1768年，與多數年表所列的前1763年略有出入。里姆辛的六十個年名之中，帶有戰爭內容的約有二十餘個，說明幾乎每年都有一次軍事行動。拉爾薩城址今名泰勒-奧馬里，在迪卡爾省舒特拉城附近，位於北緯三十一點五五度、東經四十五點四五分。幼發拉底河全長約二千八百公里，其中在伊拉克境內約一千二百公里；沙塔-恩-納希爾運河長度在數十公里量級，是拉爾薩的糧道與水上防線。圍城工程的規模只見於巴比倫王室的頌辭：銘文稱環城所挖壕溝長二十個雙時辰，按古代行軍速度折算約四十小時行程，一說達七十至八十公里，譯本數字有出入。兵器方面，每輛戰車配一御者一戰士與四匹挽馬；步兵以數十至數百人為一隊，其總人數無可靠記載，只知拉爾薩聯軍在兵車數量上佔優。糧秣方面史料無數，若按古代步兵每日每人約一公斤穀物的常規用量推算，數千人的部隊每日需糧數噸。漢摩拉比勝利碑高約一米八二，現藏於巴黎羅浮宮，是記錄這一役最重要的實物。
dataEn: The usable figures are roughly these. Rim-Sin I reigned for about sixty years; the Chinese Wikipedia article on Rim-Sin I gives his rule as approximately 1822 BC to approximately 1763 BC, and his year names survive in the Rim-Sin I Year Names archived at CDLI. The same article also gives the occupation of Larsa by the allied army as about 1768 BC, which differs slightly from the 1763 BC accepted in most chronologies. Of Rim-Sin's sixty year names, some twenty-odd carry a martial meaning, which shows that almost every year of the reign saw some military undertaking. The site of Larsa, now Tell el-Omari near Shatra in Dhi Qar, lies at about 31.55 degrees north and 45.45 degrees east. The Euphrates runs roughly 2,800 kilometres in all, of which about 1,200 are inside Iraq, and the Shatt-en-Nahil canal is on the order of several tens of kilometres, forming both the grain road and the water line of defence of Larsa. The scale of the siege works survives only in the Babylonian royal encomium: the inscription gives the encircling ditch a length of twenty double hours, which by ancient marching rates works out to about forty hours of travel, put by one reading at seventy to eighty kilometres; the figures differ between translations. As for weapons, each war chariot carried one driver, one warrior and four draught animals; infantry were organised in units of tens to hundreds, and no reliable total survives, though the Larsa coalition clearly had the advantage in numbers of chariots. There is no recorded figure for grain, but on the conventional allowance of roughly one kilogram of grain per soldier per day, a force of several thousand men would have needed several tonnes every day. The Victory Stele of Hammurabi stands about 1.82 metres high and is kept in the Louvre in Paris; it is the most important surviving object connected with this campaign.
cause: 一場衝突的起因要從里姆辛一世即位時的南部政治格局說起。拉爾薩本只是幼發拉底下游一個中等城邦，與巴比倫同出阿摩利特人，兩國王族互有血緣，因此早年多半以盟友相處；但巴比倫控制中游航路與南北商道，拉爾薩則握有下游客源與通往波斯灣的鹽路，兩者在商業上的互補轉為競爭。里姆辛即位後把軍隊與年名制度都用來鞏固下游客源的歸屬，先後拉攏埃什努納，又透過埃蘭王庭取得南方的支援；埃蘭希望削弱巴比倫，願意出兵，但要求拉爾薩承認埃什努納的獨立，這就埋下日後反目之因。馬里的處境最為艱難：齊姆里利姆既不肯完全倒向巴比倫，也不能容忍拉爾薩與埃蘭逼近中游，於是兩度遷都，最後在埃什努納被殺。真正引爆全面戰爭的，是巴比倫王權的更替與漢摩拉比掌權：他判定拉爾薩的強勢已不可容忍，於是以王之將軍的身分集結兵馬，選擇埃什努納倒戈的窗口，發動長期的圍城作戰，目標直指拉爾薩的城垣與王權本身。
causeEn: The origins of the conflict have to be traced to the politics of the south at the moment Rim-Sin I took the throne. Larsa had until then been a middling city-state on the lower Euphrates; Babylon and Larsa were both Amorite and their royal houses were related by blood, so the two had mostly lived as allies. But Babylon held the middle river and the north-south caravan roads, while Larsa commanded the salt route to the Persian Gulf and the lower river's sources of labour and goods, and what had been commercial complementarity turned into rivalry. Once he was king, Rim-Sin used the army and the year-name system to nail down the allegiance of the lower river's resources, drawing Eshnunna to his side and gaining southern support through the court of Elam. Elam wanted to weaken Babylon and was willing to send troops, but demanded that Larsa recognise Eshnunna's independence, and that condition sowed the seed of their later quarrel. Mari's position was the most exposed: Zimri-Lim would not commit himself wholly to Babylon, yet could not tolerate Larsa and Elam pressing towards the middle river, so he moved his capital twice and was finally killed at Eshnunna. What truly lit the fuse was a change of hands on the Babylonian throne and Hammurabi's ascendancy: judging that the strength of Larsa could no longer be tolerated, he gathered his forces in the capacity of the king's general, chose the moment when Eshnunna's defection had opened the way, and launched a long siege whose object was the walls of Larsa and the kingship itself.
impact: 拉爾薩的陷落改變了兩河流域的權力地圖。幼發拉底中下游自此歸於巴比倫一家的直接統治，拉爾薩作為獨立的阿摩利特政權在文獻中迅速淡出，只餘年名與信件上的痕跡；城邦並入王室的過程，使巴比倫得以推行更集中的徵召與更嚴格的軍令，也為其後的官僚化與文書管理打了基礎。埃什努納隨即被漢摩拉比吞併，馬里則在前1761年前後被徹底摧毀，兩河流域在四五十年間經歷了一輪大規模的城市重整與人口再分配，這些都是軍隊與行政的結果，而不再是一次外交仲裁。埃蘭在南方仍是威脅，兩河流域此後仍要面對伊朗高原的捲入，直到中王國時代才出現新的均勢。從文獻學看，里姆辛六十個年名連同馬里信件、埃什努納往來書函，是兩河流域早期政治與軍事記錄的核心材料，後世的王表、年表與土地研究都靠它們重建；而這場衝突留下的另一份遺產，是巴比倫第一王朝在拉爾薩廢墟上建立的新秩序，該秩序延續到中王國時代的崩潰，舊城垣的殘基至今仍留在幼發拉底下游的鹽沼地帶。
impactEn: The fall of Larsa redrew the political map of Mesopotamia. The middle and lower Euphrates passed directly under the rule of the Babylonian house, and Larsa as an independent Amorite polity quickly faded from the records, surviving only in year names and on the edges of a few letters. The absorption of the city-states into the crown's administration allowed Babylon to operate far more centralised levies and a far stricter military discipline, and it laid the groundwork for the later bureaucratisation and record-keeping of the kingdom. Eshnunna was swallowed by Hammurabi soon afterwards, and Mari was utterly destroyed around 1761 BC; the great cities of the two rivers passed through a large-scale reorganisation and reallocation of population within a generation or two, a result of armies and administration rather than of any diplomatic arbitration. Elam remained a threat in the south, and the two rivers were to be drawn back into the politics of the Iranian plateau until a new balance appeared in the Middle Kingdom period. In terms of scholarship, Rim-Sin's sixty year names, together with the Mari letters and the correspondence of Eshnunna, are core material for the political and military history of early Mesopotamia, and every later king list, chronology and land study is reconstructed from them. The other legacy of this conflict is the new order built by the first dynasty of Babylon on the ruins of Larsa, an order that lasted until the collapse of the Middle Kingdom and whose broken walls still stand in the salt flats of the lower Euphrates.
result: 前1763年，巴比倫軍隊完成對拉爾薩的長期圍困，壕溝合攏、水路被封之後，撞槌開始撞擊城牆，缺口一旦打開，步兵即湧入城內；里姆辛王朝的末代君主恩南納圖姆二世與城防軍在城破之日被擒，前1763年之後拉爾薩再沒有獨立的王與獨立的軍。巴比倫方面的官方記載把這一役列為漢摩拉比在位第三十年的功業之一，爾後漢摩拉比本人登基為王，收編拉爾薩的城邑與其控制下的下游客源，又先後消滅埃什努納與馬里，把幼發拉底河從上游到下游的航路完整地握在王國手中。就里姆辛一世本人而言，他已在戰爭真正決定勝負之前死去，他的王朝延續了數十年，最終由他的兒子承擔了全部敗局；而拉爾薩城在陷落後的廢墟長期是阿摩利特人最痛的一塊記憶，數百年後當巴比倫自身在赫梯人手下崩潰時，那座曾經堅固的都城早已只剩土丘與鹽殼。
resultEn: In 1763 BC the Babylonian army completed its long siege of Larsa: once the ditch was closed and the waterways sealed, the battering rams began to strike the walls, and as soon as a breach opened the infantry poured in. Enannatum II, the last ruler of Rim-Sin's house, and the garrison were taken on the day the city fell, and after 1763 BC Larsa had neither a king of its own nor an army of its own. The Babylonian official account lists the campaign among the deeds of the thirtieth year of Hammurabi's reign, and Hammurabi himself then took the throne, taking over Larsa's towns and the lower river's resources and going on to destroy Eshnunna and Mari, so that the whole Euphrates navigation from its upper reaches to its mouth lay in the hands of a single kingdom. As for Rim-Sin I himself, he had died before the war was truly decided; his dynasty had lasted for decades and his son bore the whole of the defeat. The ruins of Larsa long remained the sharpest memory the Amorites carried, and centuries later, when Babylon itself fell to the Hittites, that once formidable capital had long since been reduced to a mound and a salt crust.
